xna-type.name: NetworkSessionProperties
xna-type.summary: Describes custom, game-specific information about a NetworkSession object.
xna-type.remarks: Examples of custom properties include specifying the current game mode or the current level selection. Use these properties to filter the results from a search using the Find or BeginFind methods.

constructor.summary: Creates an empty instance of NetworkSessionProperties.

property.name: Count
property.summary: Gets the number of custom session properties.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Gets or sets a custom session property value at the specified index

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Gets an enumerator for iterating over the custom property values.

overload.summary: Gets an enumerator for iterating over the custom property values.
overload.returns: An enumerator for iterating over the custom property values.
